title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 82
paragraphs: While they were still in doubt, a trireme manned by Tenians arrived, deserting from the enemy, commanded by Panaitios son of Sosimenes, which brought them the whole truth. For this deed the Tenians were inscribed at Delphi on the tripod among those who had conquered the barbarians. With this ship deserting at Salamis, and the Lemnian ship that had deserted earlier and come to Artemisium, the Greek naval force reached the complete number of 380 ships — for before this two were still lacking to fill that total.
